rules: NEW maps arcane to force for this spell only and allocates7d10force+8d10fire, exactly15d10. Both components are substantive; no new damage taxonomy or30d10. NEW radius60 sphere at a perceived legal center within120, all exposed creatures including caster/allies; CON full/half per part and RC9-MIXED-172 aggregate. Nuclear is fantasy wording, not radiation, fallout disease, infinite energy or chain reaction.

NEW actual exposed terrain surface intersections become permanent charred/rough scars. On natural soil/vegetation patches the scar is difficult terrain (each foot costs2), ordinary existing vegetation in that exact footprint becomes dead charred material with the same ID and mass, and footing is rough. This substantive physical result does not spontaneously undermine structural support, lower ground, invent mineral stock, damage separately worn gear or restore resources. Stone/metal keeps its substrate/mass but is physically blackened/roughened, also difficult terrain; an actual source-specific impervious/protected surface uses that source. Exact partial intersection is required; never replace an entire ground object for one corner.

NEW separate rank9 magical residue inhabits the same scar footprint Until dispelled and prevents ordinary vegetative regrowth there while active. Its active local expression is a visible faint violet glimmer over the actual scar, sufficient to perceive that effect but not to diagnose unrelated magic. It causes no recurring damage or heat. Suppression removes the glimmer and regrowth inhibition locally, with physical scar/difficult terrain/dead vegetation unchanged; resumption restores only the still-live expression. Actual successful dispel ends the magical source and never restores HP, vegetation, mass, item stock or past footing. Independent physical repair/growth needs an actual source procedure and current material; spell ending grants none.

A new legal paid cast can damage again. It records a new source/residue without duplicating terrain material; repeated scorch of already charred stock is idempotent. Same-caster new residue replaces that caster's old residue at its old footprint only after successful new establishment; other owners' residues remain distinct, but overlapping regrowth prohibition/difficult terrain never multiply costs. Failed/countered/suppressed recast leaves old residue. No concentration slot is required by Until dispelled.
